entries.title: Cover exact workflow batch limit
entries.rationale: Accepted as a narrow regression test for the 128-channel request boundary. It is coupled to the multi-channel workflow listing security batch and should land only with that implementation.
entries.dependency_resolution: Implement with the multi-channel workflow listing adaptation so the test exercises the same batching contract.

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after the linked workflow security batch, focused boundary test, dependency screening, compatibility checks, and desktop/Tauri gates.

verification: Full-SHA diff, exact 128/129 boundary test, dependency relationship, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; no source implementation made.
